summary: Portable adjustable aluminum laptop stands are sold by at least five named competitors across Walmart and Best Buy, with confirmed prices from $23.39 to $59.99 (one Best Buy listing shows a $99.99 comparison value that could not be confirmed as a live selling price). This sits mostly inside the $25-60 band, with the cheapest confirmed competitor $1.61 below the floor. All evidence in this file is WebSearch-snippet text, not a direct page read; the underlying commerce domains are blocked at the network proxy, so every claim is search-snippet-only (see flags). The strongest, most-repeated customer complaints are wobble/instability (especially on soft surfaces or under active typing) and laptops slipping off short support arms; scratching is a secondary, addressed-by-padding concern. Demonstration value for paid video is high: opening the stand and raising a laptop to eye level is a clean, silent, self-explanatory 5-second shot.

facts.claim: Jumper Laptop Stand for Desk, Aluminum Adjustable, lists at $30.46 on Walmart.com.
Nulaxy Laptop Stand, Ergonomic Height Angle Adjustable Riser Holder (Silver), lists at $23.39 on Walmart.com.
Nulaxy Adjustable Aluminum Laptop Stand, Riser, Notebook Holder (Space Grey), lists at $42.00 on Walmart.com and was shown out of stock at the time of search.
Nulaxy Laptop Stand, Ergonomic Sit-to-Stand Holder Convertor (Silver), lists at $59.99 on Walmart.com.

Target and Best Buy each carry multiple named adjustable aluminum laptop stand brands (Mount-It!, Uncaged Ergonomics WorkEZ, iMountek, Dartwood, Lifelong at Target; MUNBYN, Staples TECH, Mybat Pro at Best Buy), indicating a broad multi-retailer category, though exact prices for most of these specific listings were not visible in search snippets.
A recurring customer complaint across multiple Amazon listings is that the stand wobbles or topples, particularly under active typing or with a heavier 15-inch laptop.
A recurring customer complaint is that short support arms let the laptop slip or nearly fall off the stand.
Reviews note stands that perform fine on a hard desk become noticeably unstable on carpet, a bed, or other soft surfaces.
Scratching (of the laptop or the desk) is a recognized concern for metal stands; multiple competing listings market silicone/rubber pads specifically to address it.

differentiation.angle: Wider non-slip tripod-style base plus a locking (not friction-only) hinge, marketed as stable on carpet, bed trays and under active typing
differentiation.rationale: Directly answers the two most repeated complaints (wobble, instability on soft surfaces); the generic single-arm friction-hinge design most competitors use is the structural cause.

differentiation.angle: Deep-lip silicone cradle demonstrated on camera holding a laptop at a steep angle without sliding
differentiation.rationale: Addresses the slipping complaint; testable in content only if the sourced unit is confirmed to have adequate arm/lip depth before the claim is made in an ad.

differentiation.angle: Scratch-free guarantee shown via a close-up demo (dragging a key or coin across the silicone pad with no mark)
differentiation.rationale: Turns an acknowledged category concern into a concrete, filmable proof point rather than a bare claim.

paid_ads_fit.silent_5s_demo: Strong - unfolding the stand and sliding a laptop onto it so the screen visibly rises to eye level reads clearly with no audio needed.
paid_ads_fit.buyer: Remote/hybrid workers, students and digital nomads who work from a desk, bed or cafe table.
paid_ads_fit.policy_hazard: Low, provided ad copy avoids implying a medical or therapeutic outcome (e.g. 'cures neck pain', 'fixes your posture'); Meta and TikTok restrict health-outcome claims. Ergonomic-comfort and desk-setup framing only.

gate_G8.reason: Three of four confirmed FACT prices ($30.46, $42.00, $59.99) sit inside the $25-60 band; the fourth confirmed price ($23.39) sits $1.61 below the floor. The observed median ($36.23) sits comfortably inside the band, so a launch price in the $30-45 range is supportable by observed competition.
